title: Scaling a Tech Team Under Pressure
challenge: A fast-growing technology firm needed to hire 15 specialised software engineers within 45 days to meet a critical product launch deadline.
approach: We activated a targeted search across our technology talent network, combined with proactive outreach to passive candidates with the specific stack requirements.
result: All 15 positions were filled within 38 days. The product launched on schedule, and 13 of the 15 placements remain with the client 18 months later.

result: 30 specialist professionals placed within the agreed timeline. The project commenced on schedule with a full specialist team.

name: Alex Morgan
